segments.en: Life, peace, and complete joy and complete healing of soul and body, and all good forever — to the honored self of my beloved dear brother, my soul's companion — his soul is bound to mine very greatly — my soul thirsts to see him — the distinguished talmid chacham, the Chassid, greatly distinguished in fear of Hashem — who drinks living waters from the well of living waters — Na Nach Nachma Nachman MayUman [מננמ"ח] — the distinguished Torah scholar, our Master [name missing], may he live and be strong.
